description: This file implements module transformation logic for the Playwright testing framework, including source map support, Babel integration, TypeScript config resolution, and custom module resolution hooks.

methods.name: setTransformConfig
methods.description: Sets the Babel plugins and external files for transformation.

methods.name: setSingleTSConfig
methods.description: Sets a specific TypeScript configuration file path.

methods.name: singleTSConfig
methods.description: Gets the current TypeScript configuration file path.

methods.name: transformHook
methods.description: Transforms source code using Babel and other preprocessors, with caching.

methods.name: requireOrImport
methods.description: Dynamically requires or imports a module, with source map support and caching.

methods.name: wrapFunctionWithLocation
methods.description: Wraps a function to include source location information from the call stack.
